versions.content: When a BswMModeCondition has BswMConditionType = BSWM_EVENT_IS_CLEARED and references a BswMEventRequestPort : • if the BswMEventRequestPort is in a SET state, then the BswMModeCondi- tion shall evaluate to FALSE • if the BswMEventRequestPort is in a CLEAR state, then the BswMModeCon- dition shall evaluate to TRUE
